qualityGates.name: Identity consistency
qualityGates.rule: Same recognizably original face throughout motion; compare stills and recorded motion

qualityGates.name: Eyes and blink realism
qualityGates.rule: Realistic eyelid deformation, proper eye occlusion, reflections and natural gaze; no sliding overlays

qualityGates.name: 3D head behavior
qualityGates.rule: Head movement exhibits correct geometry and parallax, no flat canvas translations masquerading as 3D

qualityGates.name: Voice-first interaction
qualityGates.rule: Speak command and receive visible motion response without buttons

qualityGates.name: Performance
qualityGates.rule: Measure FPS frame-time p95, startup, CPU, memory on connected Quadro K1200 machine

qualityGates.name: Truthful reporting
qualityGates.rule: Do not call placeholder portrait animation a photorealistic talking avatar
